question: What do we know about the generational wealth transfer, and how are these five preparing for it?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Morgan Stanley's integrated firm strategy positions it to support clients throughout an entire life cycle, engaging entire families and facilitating multi-generational wealth planning, including solutions for founders and employees, family office solutions, and trust & estate planning.
items.quote: We have scaled capabilities and a business mix that can support our clients throughout an entire life cycle... Our Morgan Stanley at Work business, with its exclusive partnership with Carta, positions us as an early trusted advisor to over 50,000 private companies.

items.text: Morgan Stanley offers a range of capabilities to serve clients across growth cycles, including Founders Wealth Strategies, Family Office Solutions, Trust & Estate Planning, and Full-Service Wealth Advice and Asset Allocation, which facilitate multi-generational wealth planning.
items.quote: Financial Wellness and Employee Benefits / Founders Wealth Strategies / Full-Service Wealth Advice and Asset Allocation / Family Office Solutions, Trust & Estate Planning

items.text: Morgan Stanley highlights family office and OCIO, along with tailored lending, among capabilities being broadened for financial advisors, which supports engaging ultra-high net worth families.
items.quote: We are using our scale to invest in broadening capabilities for FAs that are difficult for others to replicate: alternatives and privates, tax-efficient investing, digitized assets, family office and OCIO, and tailored lending.

items.text: Morgan Stanley provides ultra-high net worth family office infrastructure solutions, which facilitate engaging entire families and multi-generational wealth planning.
items.quote: then importantly, for ultra-high net worth family office infrastructure solutions.

items.text: Morgan Stanley has done work on servicing founders and family offices, deepening Wealth Management coverage of individuals across their journey.
items.quote: We've done a lot of work on trying to service founders, on trying to service family offices. There are all different places when you can think about how we've grown our Wealth Management business in terms of the types of coverage we give to the individuals.

items.text: Morgan Stanley's integrated firm proposition is that a trusted advisor to a founder can be connected to a wealth manager, who can then work with the investment banker, facilitating engagement across the founder's family and business wealth.
items.quote: you may be trusted advisor to a founder, and that founder may have a relationship with a wealth manager, and that wealth manager then can work with the investment banker.

cells.reason: Multiple passages describe Morgan Stanley's engagement of families and multi-generational wealth planning through family office solutions, trust & estate planning, founder wealth strategies, and integrated-firm lifecycle coverage.
